components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Shared violet action, including console purchase and renewal. Fill stays primary 600 in both themes.
components.css: .ds-primary{font-family:system-ui,-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'Segoe UI',Roboto,'Helvetica Neue',Arial,'PingFang SC','Hiragino Sans GB','Microsoft YaHei',sans-serif;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;min-height:36px;border:0;border-radius:8px;padding:8px 12px;font-size:14px;line-height:20px;font-weight:500;transition:background-color 150ms ease-out,border-color 150ms ease-out;background:#635bce;color:#fff}.ds-primary:hover{background:#5146b5}.ds-primary:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--console-accent,#635bce);outline-offset:3px}.ds-primary:disabled{opacity:.5;cursor:not-allowed}

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Neutral bordered action. Host dark class selects the shared slate control variant.
components.css: .ds-secondary{font-family:system-ui,-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'Segoe UI',Roboto,'Helvetica Neue',Arial,'PingFang SC','Hiragino Sans GB','Microsoft YaHei',sans-serif;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;min-height:36px;border:0;border-radius:8px;padding:8px 12px;font-size:14px;line-height:20px;font-weight:500;transition:background-color 150ms ease-out,border-color 150ms ease-out;border:1px solid #e5e7eb;background:#fff;color:#374151}.ds-secondary:hover{background:#f9fafb;border-color:#d1d5db}.ds-secondary:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--console-accent,#635bce);outline-offset:3px}.ds-secondary:disabled{opacity:.5;cursor:not-allowed}:host-context(.dark) .ds-secondary{background:#1e293b;color:#e5e7eb;border-color:#475569}:host-context(.dark) .ds-secondary:hover{background:#334155;border-color:#64748b}

components.name: Danger Button
components.description: Destructive action preserves its red semantic treatment.
components.css: .ds-danger{font-family:system-ui,-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'Segoe UI',Roboto,'Helvetica Neue',Arial,'PingFang SC','Hiragino Sans GB','Microsoft YaHei',sans-serif;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;min-height:36px;border:0;border-radius:8px;padding:8px 12px;font-size:14px;line-height:20px;font-weight:500;transition:background-color 150ms ease-out,border-color 150ms ease-out;background:#dc2626;color:#fff}.ds-danger:hover{background:#b91c1c}.ds-danger:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--console-accent,#635bce);outline-offset:3px}.ds-danger:disabled{opacity:.5;cursor:not-allowed}

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Shared 36px minimum text input with readable placeholder, focus, and disabled states.
components.html: <label class="ds-label" for="ds-query">Search records</label><input id="ds-query" class="ds-input" placeholder="Name or identifier" />
components.css: .ds-label{display:block;margin-bottom:6px;font:500 14px/20px system-ui,-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'Segoe UI',Roboto,'Helvetica Neue',Arial,'PingFang SC','Hiragino Sans GB','Microsoft YaHei',sans-serif;color:#374151}.ds-input{font:14px/20px system-ui,-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'Segoe UI',Roboto,'Helvetica Neue',Arial,'PingFang SC','Hiragino Sans GB','Microsoft YaHei',sans-serif;width:100%;min-height:36px;border:1px solid #e5e7eb;border-radius:8px;padding:8px 12px;background:#fff;color:#111827;transition:all 200ms}.ds-input::placeholder{color:var(--console-muted,#64748b);opacity:1}.ds-input:focus{border-color:#8171eb;box-shadow:0 0 0 2px rgb(129 113 235 / 30%)}.ds-input:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--console-accent,#635bce);outline-offset:3px}.ds-input:disabled{cursor:not-allowed;background:#f3f4f6}:host-context(.dark) .ds-label{color:#d1d5db}:host-context(.dark) .ds-input{background:#1e293b;border-color:#475569;color:#f3f4f6}:host-context(.dark) .ds-input:disabled{background:#0f172a}

components.name: Sidebar Navigation
components.description: Single pale sidebar; this excerpt shows normal and active task links, not a second navigation bar.
components.html: OverviewUsage recordsSettings
components.css: .ds-nav{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:4px;width:208px;padding:12px;background:var(--console-nav,#fbfcfe);font-family:system-ui,-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'Segoe UI',Roboto,'Helvetica Neue',Arial,'PingFang SC','Hiragino Sans GB','Microsoft YaHei',sans-serif}.ds-nav a{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;min-height:36px;padding:8px 10px;border-radius:7px;color:var(--console-muted,#64748b);text-decoration:none;font-size:13px}.ds-nav a:hover{background:var(--console-line,#e3e8ef);color:var(--console-ink,#263449)}.ds-nav a[aria-current=page]{background:var(--console-selected,#f5f3ff);color:var(--console-accent,#635bce);font-weight:600}.ds-nav a:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--console-accent,#635bce);outline-offset:3px}

components.name: Neutral Badge
components.description: Shared rounded-rectangle badge; provider pills and status dots are distinct components.
components.css: .ds-badge{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:4px;padding:2px 8px;border-radius:6px;background:#f3f4f6;color:#374151;font:500 12px/16px system-ui,-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'Segoe UI',Roboto,'Helvetica Neue',Arial,'PingFang SC','Hiragino Sans GB','Microsoft YaHei',sans-serif}:host-context(.dark) .ds-badge{background:#334155;color:#cbd5e1}

components.name: Content Panel
components.description: Flat bordered panel, illustrated with the 24px settings/checkout inset; table containers own their padding.
components.css: .ds-panel{padding:24px;border:1px solid var(--console-line,#e3e8ef);border-radius:12px;background:var(--console-surface,#fff);color:var(--console-ink,#263449);font-family:system-ui,-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'Segoe UI',Roboto,'Helvetica Neue',Arial,'PingFang SC','Hiragino Sans GB','Microsoft YaHei',sans-serif;transition:border-color 150ms}.ds-panel h3{margin:0 0 20px;font-size:15px;font-weight:600}.ds-panel p{margin:0;font-size:13px;color:var(--console-muted,#64748b)}

components.name: Settings Categories
components.description: 164px vertical directory, becoming a horizontal scrolling row below 768px. Preview shows visual states.
components.html: <nav class="ds-settings" aria-label="Settings categories"><button type="button" aria-pressed="true">General</button><button type="button" aria-pressed="false">Security</button><button type="button" aria-pressed="false">Payment</button></nav>
components.css: .ds-settings{font-family:system-ui,-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'Segoe UI',Roboto,'Helvetica Neue',Arial,'PingFang SC','Hiragino Sans GB','Microsoft YaHei',sans-serif;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:4px;width:164px}.ds-settings button{font-family:inherit;width:100%;min-height:40px;padding:8px 12px;border:0;border-radius:6px;text-align:left;background:transparent;color:var(--console-muted,#64748b);font-size:13px}.ds-settings button[aria-pressed=true]{background:var(--console-selected,#f5f3ff);color:var(--console-accent,#635bce)}.ds-settings button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--console-accent,#635bce);outline-offset:3px}@media(max-width:1023px){.ds-settings{width:160px}}@media(max-width:767px){.ds-settings{width:auto;flex-direction:row;overflow-x:auto}.ds-settings button{width:auto;min-width:max-content}}

components.name: Order Review
components.description: Sticky desktop review; becomes static below 1024px. Values are synthetic and no payment is submitted.
components.css: .ds-review{font-family:system-ui,-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'Segoe UI',Roboto,'Helvetica Neue',Arial,'PingFang SC','Hiragino Sans GB','Microsoft YaHei',sans-serif;position:sticky;top:84px;min-width:0;padding:24px;border:1px solid var(--console-line,#e3e8ef);border-radius:12px;background:var(--console-surface,#fff);color:var(--console-ink,#263449)}.ds-review h3{margin:0 0 18px;font-size:15px;font-weight:600}.ds-review-row{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:16px;font-size:14px;line-height:20px;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}.ds-review-row+.ds-review-row{margin-top:8px}.ds-review-row>span:first-child{color:#6b7280}@media(max-width:1023px){.ds-review{position:static}}

narrative.overview:
The B console is a light, professional workspace for API traffic, charges, resources, and account settings. The approved reference is Stripe: light surfaces, clear hierarchy, and restrained blue-violet accents. One pale sidebar establishes navigation, a quiet utility header holds account tools, and white content panels organize the work.

Collections use on-demand horizontal filters above records. Settings place section headings above their fields. Identity uses flat metadata and divided sections; purchasing separates editable selection from order review. Stored dark theme, configured branding, permissions, feature flags, and existing financial meaning remain authoritative.
keyCharacteristics: One light sidebar with permission-aware search and collapse.
White panels on a cool canvas with restrained violet actions and selections.
On-demand horizontal filters, compact ledgers, and explicit record counts.
Settings headings above fields, flat identity metadata, and responsive checkout columns.
Metric-switching plots, ranked distribution bars, and explicit numerical values.

rules.name: The Action Rule
rules.body: Use the shared violet primary action for console purchase and renewal; retain semantic colors for their existing data and status meanings.

rules.name: The Data Rule
rules.body: Preserve existing precision, units, currency distinctions, and labels when changing presentation.

rules.name: The Surface Rule
rules.body: Use tone and fine borders for work panels; reserve pronounced depth for overlays.

dos: Do use one sidebar, a quiet utility header, and a clear content heading.
Do use the shared violet action language for purchase and renewal.
Do reveal horizontal filters on demand and preserve query state when hidden.
Do place settings section headings above fields and keep identity metadata flat.
Do preserve semantic colors, units, currency distinctions, permissions, feature flags, validation, and stored theme.
Do treat preview values and screenshots as synthetic visual evidence only.
donts: Don't restore the rejected dark horizontal business bar, teal action styling, or permanent collection filter column.
Don't duplicate page titles in the utility header or use competing provider-colored console CTAs.
Don't replace labeled analytical comparisons with overlapping multi-metric fills or doughnut distributions in this workspace.
Don't erase errors, adornments, disabled behavior, or provider-owned controls for visual uniformity.
Don't apply this B-console specification to C, backend behavior, or unrelated public surfaces.
Don't interpret local screenshots or documentation as proof of deployment or live payment success.
